cause: Training/serving skew on f2 caused by a missing transform in the serving path. Joining the two tables in BigQuery on entity_id shows f1, f3, f4, f5 match exactly (mean abs diff 0, correlation 1.0) while f2 has a mean abs diff of ~7.9 and correlation ~0.88. The relationship is exact: train_f2 == ln(1 + serve_f2) (max residual ~6e-7 over all 200 joined entities). So the training pipeline applies a log1p (natural-log-of-1-plus-x) transform to f2, but the online serving path serves the raw untransformed value. The model therefore sees log-scaled f2 at training time and raw-scaled f2 at inference time.
